is: The registry every UI dispatches through: CommandSpecs with `noun.verb` ids, labels, params, editions, an enabled check and a run body that maps JSON params onto a use case.
conventions: A new command is one CommandSpec row in registry.rs with the editions that offer it, plus a run fn in its namespace leaf; the literal id lists in registry/tests.rs pin each edition's surface.
Results leave as JSON through `impl From<XResult> for serde_json::Value`, beside the run fn.
`enabled` reads session state only, never I/O.

fs.name: chat.rs
fs.role: chat.open and chat.current bodies and rendering

fs.name: message.rs
fs.role: message.recent and message.send bodies and rendering

fs.name: registry.rs
fs.role: the COMMANDS table, for_edition, find, dispatch

fs.name: registry/
fs.role: tests: each edition's surface, and dispatch end to end over the demo account

notes: Limited is offered no `chat.open`: a command an edition lacks does not exist there.
